mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, pay_date, year, month, year_month_value, testing_fee_type_id, project_id, fee_amount, user_id, attachment_ids, remark
mapper.select:
select tf.id, tf.pay_date, tf.year, tf.month,
tf.testing_fee_type_id, type.label testing_fee_type_name,
tf.project_id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number',
tf.fee_amount,
tf.user_id, u.name user_name,
tf.attachment_ids, tf.remark, tf.audit_status_enum, tf.branch_company_id, sbc.name as branch_company_name
from contract_testing_fee tf left join sys_dictionary type on tf.testing_fee_type_id = type.id and type.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join contract_project cp on tf.project_id = cp.id and cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_user u on tf.user_id = u.id and u.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_branch_company sbc on sbc.bool_delete_enum = 0 and sbc.id = tf.branch_company_id
where tf.bool_delete_enum = 0
and tf.year = #{year}
and tf.month = #{month}
and tf.project_id = #{projectId}
and tf.project_id IS NULL
and tf.testing_fee_type_id = #{testingFeeTypeId}
order by tf.pay_date

select tf.id, tf.pay_date, tf.year, tf.month,
tf.testing_fee_type_id, type.label testing_fee_type_name,
tf.project_id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number',
tf.fee_amount,
tf.user_id, u.name user_name,
tf.attachment_ids, tf.remark
from contract_testing_fee tf left join sys_dictionary type on tf.testing_fee_type_id = type.id and type.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join contract_project cp on tf.project_id = cp.id and cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_user u on tf.user_id = u.id and u.bool_delete_enum = 0
where tf.bool_delete_enum = 0
and DATE_FORMAT( cp.create_time, '%Y' ) = #{year}
and tf.project_id = #{projectId}
order by tf.pay_date desc
select sum(fee_amount) as sumAll,testing_fee_type_id as testingFeeTypeId from contract_testing_fee where project_id = #{projectId} and testing_fee_type_id = #{testingFeeTypeId}
select project_id from contract_testing_fee where year = #{year} GROUP BY project_id

SELECT year_month_value month, sum(fee_amount) amount FROM `contract_testing_fee` WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 and project_id is null and year_month_value > #{startMonth} and year_month_value <= #{endMonth} group by year_month_value order by year_month_value
